games.name: Hooked! [TRAIT]
games.desc:
⚡ In this relentless game of precision, positioning, and teamwork, your survival depends on a single weapon: the Hook. Grapple enemies to pull them out of position, or strike them down in intense team-versus-team arena battles. Every throw can turn the tide of war!

🔥 Claim victory to earn coins and build your ultimate loadout. Test your luck to roll for legendary Hook skins, and unlock game-changing abilities. Strategy is key—you can only equip ONE ability per match, so choose wisely to complement your team's playstyle!

🏆 Coordinate with your allies or carry the match! Whether you are a tactical mastermind or a casual brawler, the arena awaits.

(PC): Left Click to attack
Hold space + WASD to weave in said direction

(CONSOLE) R2 to attack
Hold L2 + move analog stick in said direction

(MOBILE) Fist button to attack
Hold Weave button + move in said direction
